about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: City of Bayonne (Bayonne MUA)
channels.legal_basis: NJPDES CSO permit NJ0109240 (final 2025-10-28), Part IV.F.8.b.iii: "maintain on a daily basis a CSO Notification System website to inform interested citizens of CSO discharges that are occurring or have occurred"
channels.note: Rain-based 'CSO event likely / unlikely' per permittee, not discharge detection; no history. The page's JSON (https://njcsonotifications.com/?handler=Status) is read by the nj-cso-likely snapshot for the rain-likely caution, so this monitor reads the HTML page the permittees link to. Clause text read in Camden City's permit NJ0108812 (final 2024-11-04); the 2023-25 renewals carry the same public-notification part (research/nj/report.md §2.1).
channels.authority: NJ CSO Group shared notification site (interim)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: EPA ECHO monthly days with CSO discharge per outfall (parameter 81381). Voluntary publication by EPA of permit-required monthly reports (NJPDES CSO permits Part IV.C.1.d: a whole day for any calendar day with a discharge); weeks to months late. https://echodata.epa.gov/echo/eff_rest_services.get_effluent_chart answered 500 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. Covers every operator in the state. (research/nj/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: No rows for this state in EPA's dataset: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. No NJ rows in the dataset (research/nj); add the state to the ingester's STATES when rows appear. Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)
channels.barrier_review: the register does not say what keeps it off the web: no rows for this state in epa's dataset: epa echo sewer overflow and bypass event records (npdes ereporting). voluntary
